title: Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna 3: Lightning Angel
native_title: 銀河お嬢様伝説 ユナ３ ～ライトニング・エンジェル～
overview:
An unprecedented fierce battle has made Yuna get serious!

A series first! Tactical adventure

Plenty to see!! Over 300 cuts of visuals and movies.

Led by Chisa Yokoyama, familiar as the voice of Yuna, a lavish cast livens up the series' greatest masterpiece.

At the greatest crisis of her young-lady life, all of Yuna's friends gather together!!

Tsukasa Kotobuki, Takehiko Ito, Fuyu Nakasaki, Haruo Ookawara and others take part as guest character designers.

Yuna, who once saved the galaxy, is back to life as an ordinary high school student - until Neo-Tokyo is plunged into darkness. The Mechanized Empire has attacked and launched a giant missile that is boring into the Earth, and only Yuna and her friends can stop it.

Story scenes alternate with turn-based tactical battles on a grid. Deploy up to eight allies, then move, attack, use items and unleash skills against the Empire's machine soldiers. Win to push the story forward - but if Yuna falls, the battle is lost. Choices and minigame results along the way can change whose route the story follows.

かつてない激戦がユナを本気にさせた！

シリーズ初！タクティカルアドベンチャー

見応え充分！！総カット300以上のビジュアル＆ムービー。

ユナ役でお馴染みの横山智佐さんをはじめ、豪華キャストでシリーズ最高傑作を盛り上げるぞ。

お嬢さま人生最大の危機に、ユナの仲間たちが総結集！！

ことぶきつかさ氏、伊東岳彦氏、なかさき冬氏、大河原晴男氏などが、ゲスト・キャラデザイナーとして参加。
